intro.text: An alliance of Roshar's nations that Dalinar Kholin sets out to build from Urithiru, to stand together against the enemy's coming forces.

description.text: At the first meeting of monarchs, Navani asked each ruler to carry their own chair, as a sign of equality and of bringing wisdom to the meeting.
Its headquarters, Urithiru, shelters people driven from lands the enemy has taken, and its Oathgates let the coalition move armies and supplies across the continent.
Each member brings its strengths: Veden surgeons, the Thaylen navy controlling the southern seas, and the Alethi army, which also trains the Azish. Allied Radiants heal, Soulcast food and fight.
Dalinar and Shallan together make a three-dimensional map of Roshar from Stormlight, refreshed with each highstorm, which the coalition uses for military planning.

items.text: After a vision of the enemy's champion, Dalinar feels he must unite Roshar's nations, and decides to start with the kingdoms and cities that have Oathgates.
His team reaches out by spanreed. Azir and Thaylenah rebuff him, Yezier and Tashikk turn him down, and Iri sides with the Voidbringers. Only Taravangian accepts.
In Thaylen City Dalinar lets Fen's son stab him in a duel to prove his peaceful intent, but it is his work rebuilding a temple and Renarin's healing that persuade Fen to join.
At Fen's suggestion Dalinar goes to Azimir alone with essays by Fen, Navani and Jasnah. Impressed, Yanagawn and the viziers agree to visit Urithiru.
The first meeting of monarchs gathers rulers and envoys from Alethkar, Azir, Emul, Yezier, Tashikk, Thaylenah, Jah Keved and Natanatan.
A meeting of the coalition falls into chaos, with trust in Dalinar and the coalition's purpose broken.
Azir and Taravangian abandon the coalition; Fen reluctantly stays. When the enemy attacks Thaylen City under the Everstorm, the Alethi and Thaylens defend it.
The coalition recognises Dalinar as king of Urithiru in return for his renouncing any claim over other monarchs, and holds meetings to plan and share knowledge.
The monarchs agree to an offensive into Emul, and send a diplomatic group to Lasting Integrity to renew relations with the honorspren.
Kharbranth declares itself neutral, and Jah Keved sides with the singers.
After several more battles the coalition wins Emul, and the monarchs turn to recovering Urithiru.
